user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and surfacing website content in search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Visits pages submitted as ads; not used for foundation model training.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content used in training OpenAI's generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and interactions with external applications; not automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for model development and training.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content when users ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes web content to enhance search result relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Web content indexed for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Builds Google search indexes and performs crawls for related Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls image content for Google Images and related features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content specifically for Google News services.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, news.google.com, and Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for all surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Executes crawls for Search testing tools in Search Console.
user_agents.scope: Rich Result Test and URL inspection tools; no effect on Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and various product teams.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible site content used for internal research and development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs used across various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs used across various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Building Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training Gemini models and grounding for Gemini and Vertex AI.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically to improve search.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features and collects data for training Apple foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web search crawling and rendering across Apple products and generative AI features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls usage of crawled data for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent determining data use for training generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content associated with Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display previews.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays title, description, and thumbnail image for shared links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to enhance Meta advertising and business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for training foundation AI models or direct indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow meta-externalagent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI.
user_agents.scope: Fetches user-requested links and helps AI navigate websites to complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train AI models.
user_agents.scope: Improve Amazon products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Amazon search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions and fetch live web info for user queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetch live web info for user queries; not for generative AI.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler collecting internet data for open research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls a randomly selected sample of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent: CCBot or use opt-out registry.
